content: UniMind AI is a campus assistant website that helps students, faculty, and admins with timetable queries, events, hostel support, placement updates, notifications, and profile-based AI responses.
Student-facing modules include dashboard chat assistant, academic schedule, campus events, hostel services, placement cell, navigation help, faculty directory, notifications, and profile settings.
Faculty and admin users can use the staff portal to post events, publish notifications, and update department-wise timetable rows.
Role behavior: students mainly consume data; faculty and admin can manage operational data from the staff portal.
Users can login from the login page with email and password. After successful login, they are redirected to dashboard.
New users can register with name, email, password, and role. Password and confirm password must match.
Logout clears local session data like campusUser, studentProfile, and chatSessionId, then redirects to home page.
Student profile fields are name, email, department, age, and semester. These fields are used to personalize AI answers.
Profile completion improves answer quality for department-specific timetable and notifications.
The chatbot keeps short conversation history using a session id so follow-up questions can be answered with context.
The chatbot supports multiple Indian languages including English, Hindi, Marathi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia, Assamese, and Urdu.
Academic schedule page can render department timetable in table format with day and time slots.
Staff can publish events with title, date, venue, audience, and description from the portal.
Staff can post notifications with title, audience, and message. Students can view relevant notifications.
Hostel services module includes room availability information and waiting list updates.
Placement module shows current drives, eligibility snapshots, and preparation activities.
For best experience use a modern browser and stable internet so chat and API requests can complete.
If chatbot says it cannot reach backend API, start Flask server and verify API base URL configuration.
For greetings, the assistant can respond casually and suggest asking timetable, events, hostel, placement, or notifications queries.
Operational values like events, timetable rows, and notification announcements can change whenever faculty/admin post updates.
